AK.office: Alaska Division of Employment and Training Services, FLC program
AK.note: Send your housing inspection request at least 31 days before your start date.

AR.office: Arkansas Workforce Connections, Foreign Labor Certification Team
AR.note: Use the inspection request form on the state's page.

CO.office: Colorado Department of Labor and Employment, Foreign Labor Certification Unit
CO.note: A local workforce center representative contacts you to do the pre-occupancy inspection.

CT.office: Connecticut Department of Labor, Foreign Labor Certification Unit

FL.office: Your county Florida Department of Health office
FL.note: In Florida, migrant labor housing permits and inspections are handled by the county health department.

MD.office: Maryland Department of Labor, Foreign Labor Certification Unit
MD.note: The unit contacts you to schedule the inspection once your job order is submitted through FLAG.

MS.office: Mississippi Department of Employment Security, Foreign Labor Certification
MS.note: The Foreign Labor Certification Officer or the nearest WIN Job Center handles inspections. Find the right contact on the state's page.

NY.office: Your local health department (New York State Department of Health)
NY.note: Contact your local health department to start your housing permit and inspection.

OR.office: Oregon OSHA (housing) and Oregon Employment Department (job orders)
OR.note: The phone number is Oregon OSHA's. Oregon OSHA approves housing for first-time H-2A employers. Returning employers may qualify for certification through the Oregon Employment Department.

RI.office: Rhode Island Department of Labor and Training
RI.note: The housing inspection must be completed 32 days before your date of need.

SD.office: South Dakota Department of Labor and Regulation, Foreign Labor Certification
SD.note: Returning employers can have housing inspected before filing. First-time filers must file the job order first.

TN.office: Tennessee Department of Labor, H-2A program
TN.note: Find the right contact on the state H-2A page.

TX.office: Texas Workforce Commission, Foreign Labor Certification

VA.note: Find the right contact on the agriculture staff page.
